Multi-Model AI Image Classifier

This Streamlit app allows you to classify images using **MobileNetV2**, **ResNet50**, or **EfficientNetB0** models pretrained on ImageNet.

 Features
- Upload an image (jpg, jpeg, png)
- Choose a model
- Get predicted class in real-time
 Installation
1. Clone the repo:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sumanth756968/<image-classification>.git
